weight_rule: Each source-label cell has total weight N/4, computed on training rows only.
split: Reuse G1.6 assignments exactly, never reroll seed.
comparison: Report FPR, recall, precision, AP, ROC AUC, confusion matrix and paired error changes separately for each validation source.
selection: No automatic winner, no production acceptance claim, no threshold search.
limitations: Hypotheses were informed by already-observed validation errors. This is exploratory validation, not a final test. Historical labels remain unchanged.
